alias_docs.Account: Discriminated union over the three account variants, dispatched on the type field; build one from a dict with pydantic.TypeAdapter(Account).
alias_docs.AccountType: Discriminator of the Account union and AccountSummary.type: service_account, oauth_browser, or oauth_token.
alias_docs.BUSINESS_CONTEXT_MAX_CHARS: Maximum length of a business-context document in characters; the server rejects longer content and set_business_context checks it before sending.
alias_docs.BookmarkType: Saved report type from the Bookmarks API (BookmarkInfo.type, list_bookmarks, list_bookmarks_v2, saved_report_link).
alias_docs.CohortAggregationType: Aggregation over a numeric property in CohortCriteria.did_event (aggregation) cohort behavior criteria.
alias_docs.ConversionWindowUnit: Unit of the funnel conversion window (conversion_window_unit) in Workspace.query_funnel / build_funnel_params.
alias_docs.CountType: Counting method for the legacy live queries that take a type parameter: total events, unique users, or the average per user.
alias_docs.CustomPropertyType: Output type of a custom property (CreateCustomPropertyParams.property_type, GroupBy.property_type, SubPropertyInfo.type).
alias_docs.EntityType: Lexicon entity kind (event or profile) for Workspace.lexicon_schemas / lexicon_schema (entity_type).
alias_docs.FilterDateUnit: Unit of the relative window in Filter.in_the_last, in_the_next, and not_in_the_last (date_unit).
alias_docs.FilterOperator: Canonical wire spelling of a Filter operator as stored in bookmark JSON.
alias_docs.FilterPropertyType: Property data type of a Filter condition (property_type), including list and object for nested data.
alias_docs.FiltersCombinator: How the filters on a Metric, FunnelStep, RetentionEvent, or FlowStep combine: all (AND) or any (OR).
alias_docs.FlowAnchorType: Anchor kind in a flow tree result (FlowTreeNode.anchor_type / FlowStepNode.anchorType).
alias_docs.FlowChartType: Visualization mode of a flow query result, passed as the mode parameter of the flow engine methods and of flow report links.
alias_docs.FlowConversionWindowUnit: Unit of the flow conversion window (conversion_window_unit) in Workspace.query_flow / build_flow_params; no sub-day units.
alias_docs.FlowCountType: Counting method for Workspace.query_flow / build_flow_params (count_type): unique users, total events, or sessions.
alias_docs.FlowNodeType: Node kind in a flow tree result (FlowTreeNode.type / FlowStepNode.type), such as ANCHOR or DROPOFF.
alias_docs.FlowSessionEvent: Session anchor for FlowStep.session_event: the start or the end of a session.
alias_docs.FrequencyFilterOperator: Comparison operator for FrequencyFilter.operator; single-value operators only, no between.
alias_docs.FunnelMathType: Aggregation for Workspace.query_funnel / build_funnel_params (math), including the conversion_rate_* variants.
alias_docs.FunnelMode: Display mode for Workspace.query_funnel / build_funnel_params (mode): steps, trends, or table.
alias_docs.FunnelOrder: Step ordering for FunnelStep.order: loose (in order, other events allowed between steps) or any.
alias_docs.FunnelReentryMode: Re-entry handling for Workspace.query_funnel / build_funnel_params (reentry_mode) when a user restarts the funnel.
alias_docs.HelpDomainReason: Why HelpDomainError rejected the domain filter of a help query (HelpDomainError.reason); each reason selects a different message.
alias_docs.HourDayUnit: Bucket size for the numeric live queries segmentation_numeric, segmentation_sum, and segmentation_average, and the addiction_unit of frequency.
alias_docs.InsightsMode: Display mode for Workspace.query / build_params (mode): timeseries, total, or table.
alias_docs.MathType: Aggregation for a plain-string event in Workspace.query / build_params and for Metric.math.
alias_docs.PerUserAggregation: Per-user pre-aggregation applied before math in Workspace.query / build_params and Metric.per_user; requires math_property.
alias_docs.PropertySpec: Any way of naming a property in a query parameter: a plain property name or a custom-property reference (Metric.property, GroupBy.property, and the Filter class-method property arguments).
alias_docs.QueryTimeUnit: Time bucket for the unit parameter of Workspace.query, query_funnel, query_retention, and their build_* helpers.
alias_docs.Region: Mixpanel data residency region (us, eu, in) used by accounts, sessions, and report links.
alias_docs.ReportLinkQueryResult: Typed result of Workspace.query_report_link; the concrete class follows the link's report type, so narrow with isinstance or ResolvedReport.report_type.
alias_docs.ReportLinkType: Report type of a shareable report link: Workspace.create_report_link (report_type), ReportLink.report_type, and the bookmark_type of query_saved_report; excludes launch-analysis.
alias_docs.RetentionAlignment: Cohort alignment for Workspace.query_retention / build_retention_params (alignment): birth or interval_start.
alias_docs.RetentionMathType: Measurement math for Workspace.query_retention / build_retention_params (math); retention_rate is the default.
alias_docs.RetentionMode: Display mode for Workspace.query_retention / build_retention_params (mode): curve, trends, or table.
alias_docs.RetentionUnboundedMode: Unbounded retention handling for Workspace.query_retention / build_retention_params (unbounded_mode).
alias_docs.SavedReportType: Report type detected from a saved report result (SavedReportResult.report_type); note funnel, not funnels.
alias_docs.SegmentMethod: How Metric.segment_method counts qualifying events per user: all events or the first one only.
alias_docs.TimeComparisonType: Kind of period-over-period comparison in TimeComparison.type: relative, absolute-start, or absolute-end.
alias_docs.TimeComparisonUnit: Offset unit for TimeComparison.relative / TimeComparison.unit in period-over-period comparisons.
alias_docs.TimeUnit: Bucket size for the legacy live queries segmentation, retention, event_counts, property_counts, and frequency, and the retention_unit of Workspace.query_retention / build_retention_params.
